turret-v2.png.prompt: Production sprite animation atlas for an original isometric pixel-art military RTS. Reference buildings.png is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY: olive steel, muted stone, restrained teal markings, warm upper-left highlights. NEW standalone rotating CANNON HEADS ONLY, without pedestal/building/base. Strict 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equal cells with clear gutters. Every head has the same armored octagonal gunhouse and ONE straight single barrel, no fork. Fixed mounting pivot, full clearance in every direction. First eight: screen southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, north, northeast, east. Last eight: same directions and mount, barrel slides inward as recoil, subtle orange light inside muzzle. Chunky pixel clusters, uniform geometry; no labels, shadows, grid or text.
turret-v2.png.runtime: Separate immutable pedestal and registered rotating head; explicit per-frame mounting/muzzle coordinates in art/rig.json.
